source.description: Path to a configured Sprite Source directory. Either absolute or relative to the GameMaker project folder.

collaboratorSources.description: Paths to other SpriteSource directories that may overlap with this source. Any sprites that are found in the source *and* one or more collaborator sources must be the latest in 'source' for it to be imported as part of the pipeline.

ignore.description: Pattern to match against the folder path (relative to the SpriteSource root, using POSIX seps) for it to be skipped during import. If omitted, all sprites are included. Converted to a regex with `new RegExp(ignore)`.

prefix.description: Prefix to add to the sprite name when adding to the project as a sprite asset.
